name: GMO Financial Holdings Inc
summary: Operating both within Japan and on an international scale, GMO Financial Holdings, Inc., as a subsidiary of GMO Internet Co., Ltd., specializes in providing platforms for financial product transactions and virtual currency exchanges. The company, which lists securities and foreign exchange among its key offerings, was established in 2012. Its corporate headquarters are located in Tokyo, Japan. Notably, the firm adopted its current name in October 2017, having previously been known as GMO CLICK Holdings, Inc.
